title: Would recommend the overnight trip to Tangier!
text: We were looking for a way to get from Seville to Tangier for an overnight trip. We liked that all transportation was included. They also did a good job of walking us through the ferry experience, handed us our tickets and hotel reservation, etc. Overall it felt pretty organized. We didn't have any plans for our second day and so the Tangier guide (who partners with Naturanda it seems) recommended someone for us who met us at the hotel and showed us around on day two. We were able to see a lot of the city and got back safely. It was a good experience.
